title: NxRestrict
description:
NxRestrict is a powerful GUI-based Minecraft plugin that lets you easily enable or disable gameplay features globally or per player.
It provides real-time control with no restarts, using a clean interface and instant enforcement.
body:
**Native Major MC Version:
1.21
Tested Major MC Versions:
1.161.171.181.191.201.20.61.21
Supported Restrictions:**

**Control essential gameplay features with precision:
Armor Equip Control
Block wearing, picking up, or moving armor completely
Ender Pearl Usage
Disable teleportation via pearls
Totem of Undying
Prevent resurrection on death
⛏ Block Mining
Disable block breaking
❄ Freeze Player
Completely stop player movement**

️ GUI System:

NxRestrict provides a clean and modern GUI system:
Main Control Panel:
Player Manager with pagination
Individual Player Settings
Global Restriction Panel
Back buttons & protected GUI slots
All menus are designed using a professional glass-frame layout to prevent misclicks and improve usability.
⚡ Real-Time Enforcement:
All restrictions are applied instantly using optimized event listeners:
**Armor → Inventory + Pickup + Dispenser blocked
Pearls → Interaction cancelled
Totem → Resurrection blocked
Mining → Block breaking cancelled
Freeze → Movement stopped**
